recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-5583. If future work finds problems in the live Schematron generator or in the sparse current generated Schematron content, handle that as a separate publisher/tooling or documentation issue rather than as a new source edit for this already-applied DSTU1 tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-5583 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core tooling correction reporting that generated Schematron invariants were not applied to contained resources, either under DomainResource.contained or Bundle.entry.resource.
initial_application: The Jira comments say the issue was done around SVN revision 4000. Git history shows commit 368c9c3074eeb60fb30efdb8d319e75345501ebc at build@3993 with the matching application: the old generator stopped producing Atom-feed contexts, generated invariants from resource roots, followed base-resource element types such as DomainResource, and added generated-file guidance to use fhir-invariants.sch because of containment.
additional_context: Current core source keeps Bundle and DomainResource active in source/fhir.ini and still documents generated Schematron use in source/xml.html and source/validation.html, but the current checkout has no checked-in .sch outputs or SchematronGenerator.java to edit. Current build.fhir.org Schematron output retains the historical containment guidance that fhir-invariants.sch is the file to use for validation because of containment. FHIR-8694 later refined generated context paths without reversing this fix; FHIR-27124 is a later dom-3 Schematron assertion issue already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The applied DSTU1 generator fix is historical, the current authoritative core source does not contain the generator implementation or checked-in generated .sch artifacts, and the current Schematron-facing documentation/output already carries the containment-specific instruction introduced by the historical fix.

related_jiras.note: Published follow-up for generated Schematron context paths; it cites the same contained-resource miss and was applied in git commit fe3647f429.
Later dom-3 Schematron assertion issue concerning contained-reference logic; already audited on the combined branch and not part of this seed decision.
